description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets sourced from one platform versus multiple platforms over a period of years. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order; the axis does not have a defined scale. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. Two sets of bars are presented for each year: a blue bar labeled “1+” and an orange bar labeled “2+.”  For the year 2012, the blue bar reaches approximately 1, while the orange bar is just under 1. In 2021, the blue bar reaches approximately 95, and the orange bar reaches around 48.  The bars are sorted chronologically by year. No bars appear to be visually emphasized.
